Taivo Launches as New Parent Company, Bringing Prominent Branded Merchandise Technology Brands Together

By Mike Clark on September 22, 2026

OrderMyGear, Printavo, Clarity Software, GraphicsFlow, OneSource, SignTracker, DistributorCentral, and InkSoft retain their established products and features while aligning around a more connected vision.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:09
Instaread

DALLAS, Sept. 22, 2026 – Taivo today launched as the new parent company for eight established technology products serving the branded merchandise industry: OrderMyGear, Printavo, Clarity Software, GraphicsFlow, OneSource, SignTracker, DistributorCentral, and InkSoft.

The new brand brings together over 11,000 active clients across the product suite, plus upwards of 100 years of collective industry experience, and a massive $1 billion-plus in business transactions to date. 

“Taivo’s motto for the future is: Great Individually.  Better Together. We brought together the industry’s individually great products, which we’ll continue to improve.  We’ll make those products work better together by integrating them into a cohesive suite,” said James Armijo, CEO. “With one shared vision, we can help our clients work more efficiently, serve their customers more effectively, and prepare for where the branded merchandise industry is going next.”

Taivo replaces Inktavo as the parent company name and introduces a shared identity for the portfolio. Together, Taivo’s endorsed brands support businesses across apparel, promotional products, suppliers, and signage, with a shared direction to simplify how branded merchandise is discovered, sold, decorated, produced, and fulfilled.

For clients, continuity remains central to the launch, and clients can continue using the products they already know and rely on.

Each brand will also continue supporting the distinct workflows of the businesses it serves, including suppliers, distributors, decorators, dealers, printers, and sign shops. Under Taivo, the brands will benefit from robust support, shared industry knowledge, and product expertise. All brands also benefit from a shared technology stack focused on continual product improvements, integrations, and other refinements.


“To be honest, our industries (apparel, promo, and signage) can always use more help to improve and streamline their business,’ said Bruce Ackerman, founder of Printavo. “It’s why we started, and we have a lot of work to do. We’re on an exciting journey.”

Taivo’s long-term vision is to build a more connected software ecosystem for branded merchandise, where orders can move through a more unified experience. The company plans to advance that vision through continued investment in deep, flexible functionality, connected products and data, modern user experiences, and AI-enhanced capabilities.

Through its endorsed brands, Taivo supports workflows spanning supplier product discovery, online stores, artwork management, quoting and estimating, order management, job scheduling, production, payments, reporting, and fulfillment. By bringing these capabilities together under a single parent company, Taivo is creating a stronger foundation for practical innovation throughout the branded merchandise lifecycle.

More information about Taivo and its family of brands is available at https://www.taivo.co/.

About Taivo

Taivo combines technology and industry expertise to help branded merchandise businesses operate more efficiently, serve their customers, and grow with confidence. Through its family of brands —OrderMyGear, Printavo, Clarity Software, GraphicsFlow, OneSource, SignTracker, DistributorCentral, and InkSoft—Taivo supports suppliers, distributors, decorators, dealers, printers, and sign shops across product discovery, sales, decoration, production, and fulfillment. Taivo is building a more connected ecosystem around the products, data, and workflows that power the branded merchandise industry. Learn more at https://www.taivo.co/.
